question: What is the primary purpose of Student Hub?
answer: Student Hub is a centralized, unified student portal designed to manage academic life seamlessly—including attendance tracking, assignment submissions, campus events, exam results, fee payments, class timetables, and learning resources.

question: How do I create a new student account?
answer: Click 'Create Account' or navigate to register.html. Fill in your full name, student email, 10-digit Indian mobile number, create a strong password, choose your course and year, select your gender, and accept the terms and conditions.

question: What are the password requirements during registration?
answer: Your password must contain at least 8 characters, at least one uppercase letter (A-Z), one lowercase letter (a-z), one numeric digit (0-9), and at least one special character (!@#$%^&*). A live strength meter guides you as you type.

question: How do I log in to access my student dashboard?
answer: Go to login.html, enter your registered student email and password, and click 'Login'. Upon successful authentication, you will be redirected straight to your home dashboard at home.html.

question: How does the Light and Dark Mode theme toggle work?
answer: Click the theme icon (sun/moon) on the top navigation bar or within the hamburger menu. Your preferred theme is stored in localStorage so it persists across all pages, reloads, and browser sessions.

question: Where can I find the responsive Hamburger Menu?
answer: On desktop, a quick navigation sidebar is visible, while on mobile and tablet screens, a ☰ hamburger button appears on the top bar. Clicking it slides open a full drawer linking to all 11 modules of the portal.

question: How is my subject attendance monitored?
answer: The Attendance page (attendance.html) displays overall percentage, subject-by-subject attendance stats, breakdown of classes attended versus conducted, and visual status badges alerting you if attendance drops below 75%.

question: Can I search, filter, and view assignment details?
answer: Yes! The Assignments page lets you filter by subject, search assignments by title or keyword, and click on any card to open a modal dialog displaying submission deadlines, instructions, and submission status.

question: How does the Events page load campus activities?
answer: The Events module fetches data dynamically from data/events.json using the Fetch API. It features interactive search, category filters (Technical, Workshop, Sports, Cultural, Seminar), date/title sorting, and 6-per-page pagination.

question: How can I search and filter the Student Directory?
answer: The Students page (students.html) uses Fetch API to query data/students.json. You can search by student name or email, filter by academic course or year, sort columns, and paginate through records dynamically.

question: Where can I view my semester results and grades?
answer: The Results page (results.html) breaks down previous and current semester grade points (SGPA and CGPA), credit points earned, course-wise letter grades, and academic standing.

question: How do I check fee dues and payment history?
answer: Visit fees.html to see your total semester fees, amounts paid, outstanding balance, and installment due dates. You can also trigger a demo receipt generator with toast confirmation.

question: Can I edit and update my student profile information?
answer: Yes, on profile.html you can view your personal details, enrolled course, semester, and contact information. You can edit your bio and details, which will be saved into browser localStorage.

question: What happens if a JSON data fetch fails?
answer: Every Fetch API call features complete error handling: if an issue occurs (e.g., file not found or offline), a clear error card is displayed in the DOM along with a 'Retry Loading' button and an error toast notification.

question: How do I log out securely from the portal?
answer: Click 'Logout' in the hamburger menu or top header. This clears your authentication token from localStorage, shows a confirmation toast notification, and redirects you back to the public landing page (index.html).

question: Does this portal require any backend server or frameworks?
answer: No. The entire portal is crafted with clean, semantic HTML5, modern CSS3 variables and Flexbox/Grid, and modular Vanilla ES6 JavaScript leveraging the browser DOM, Fetch API, and localStorage.
